svg.title: doc-link-monitor portfolio advert
svg.desc: A portfolio advert for doc-link-monitor, a serverless documentation link health monitor built with AWS CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB and EventBridge. Green background with pink accents. Shows a chain of links with one broken link detected by a radar pulse, with project name, tagline and tech stack.
svg.text: Register URLs. EventBridge runs Lambda every hour.
DynamoDB tracks state. SNS alerts the moment anything breaks.
